## Step 7 — Reflect and finish

Each of the three participants posts one final reflection comment in this Exercise Issue.

Use this exact prefix:

```text
REFLECTION: ...
```

Requirements:

- at least 120 characters;
- explain your own role and what you did;
- correctly use at least two of these concepts: `branch`, `commit`, `push`, `pull request`, `review`, `merge`, `local`, `remote`.

When all three reflections pass the automatic structure check, the Exercise Issue will post a completion message and close automatically.
